Ridenfaden Wednesday

Louisville, KY · Germantown · Road · Gravel · Mixed

No-drop

Ridenfaden Wednesday is a road and gravel group ride in Louisville, KY. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Seidenfaden's. Pace: no-drop group and a fast group.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop group and a fast group. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @crazyridenfadencyclists the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Ridenfaden Wednesday group ride

A year-round Wednesday ride out of a Germantown bar, with a no-drop group at 6 and a fast ride at 6:30. Everyone ends up back at Seidenfaden's by 8. Some race, some slow roll, all fine.
